title: ProcedureStep
description: One node in the dependency graph for a Procedure. M2's engine reads dependsOn to build the topological order; M1 renders each step as a graph node and its detail panel.

stepNumber.description: Display order hint only — actual execution order comes from dependsOn, not this number

title.description: Short imperative label, e.g. 'Submit online application on Aaple Sarkar'

description.description: 1-3 sentence plain-language explanation of what happens in this step

documents.description: Documents needed to complete this step, e.g. ['Rent agreement or ownership proof', 'Aadhaar card']

fee.description: Exact amount if published (number, INR) or a string like 'Not published — contact office'. null means the source doesn't charge/mention a fee for this step.

processingTime.description: e.g. '3-5 working days'. null if not stated by the source.

applicationUrl.description: Direct link to the form/portal page for this step, not the domain homepage

sourceUrl.description: The specific official page this step's facts were extracted from

dependsOn.description: Array of other step _ids that must be complete before this one. Empty array = no prerequisite (can start immediately).

dependencyReason.description: Why the dependency exists, shown as the graph edge label, e.g. 'Application form requires uploaded proof of premises'

excludedReason.description: Human-readable reason shown in the excluded-steps list when the condition fails, e.g. 'Only required for food-handling businesses'

status.description: verified = confirmed against sourceUrl by a team member; unverified = extracted but not yet double-checked; missing = the official source genuinely does not provide this field (do NOT invent a value instead)
